Job description:

This position is advertised on behalf of and authorised by Pasticceria San Valentino.

About Us

Pasticceria San Valentino is an authentic Italian patisserie and café proudly serving Sydney’s sweet offerings with artisan-made pastries, desserts, cakes, and specialty coffee. We bring traditional Italian flavours to life with a focus on craftsmanship, quality, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

We are expanding our team and are seeking a dedicated Full-Time Pastry Cook to join our Haberfield location.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and bake traditional Italian pastries such as cannoli, biscotti, crostata, maritozzi, and seasonal specialties
Produce cakes, tarts, mousses, and other Italian desserts
Follow both classic and modern recipes with accuracy and consistency
Maintain high standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and food safety
Ensure consistent product quality and presentation
Assist with daily preparation, stock rotation, and ingredient ordering
Work closely with kitchen and front-of-house teams to ensure smooth service
Requirements

Minimum 2 years of relevant pastry experience
Certificate III in Patisserie or equivalent trade qualification
Strong time management and organisational skills
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
Excellent communication and teamwork skills

At Phillip Riley we are looking for an experienced Research and Development Manager.

As our Research and Development Manager you will plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate research and development activities within an organisation.

Some of your main tasks will be:
•	Develops and implements research project strategies, priorities and targets to support commercial and policy developments
•	Work with other departmental staff to identify greatest research and development targets and priorities.
•	Work within a budget to decide which research and development projects are most worthwhile for the overall benefit to be gained by the organisation. 
•	Lead major research projects and coordinates activities of other research workers
•	Assesses the benefits and monitors the costs and effectiveness of research and development activities
•	Interprets results of research projects, and recommends associated product and service development innovations
•	Provides advice on research and development options available to the organisation
•	Monitors leading-edge developments in relevant disciplines and assesses implications for the organisation
